taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.source_trace: Trace template source selection/compilation separately from ordinary template data. Record engine/version, sandbox configuration, reachable expressions and deployment context.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local inert arithmetic/string marker through the real template compilation path. Compare user text passed as a data value with user text interpreted as template source. Inspect whether a later render/recompile step promotes previously stored content to source.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A template delimiter appearing in output is not evaluation. Ordinary escaped data substitution and client-side rendering are different boundaries. An evaluated harmless expression does not by itself demonstrate OS execution.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Keep caller content as data and restrict template-source authority according to the feature. Retest normal templates, legitimate user text and the original evaluation path; a sandbox claim requires the actual engine contract.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
